10ized7.q: If you park in a metered zone, you must display the ticket so it is clearly visible.
10ized7.why: In pay-and-display zones (parchimetro) the ticket must be displayed clearly so it can be checked.

h5klcz.q: To park in a time-disc zone, you must display the arrival time clearly.
h5klcz.why: In a time-disc zone (disco orario) you must show the disc with your arrival time clearly visible.

1gei5bn.q: In a metered parking zone you need not use the meter if you only stop to let a passenger on or off.
1gei5bn.why: Letting a passenger on or off is a stop (fermata), not parking (sosta), so no payment is required.

gbsppy.q: In time-limited parking areas, vehicles serving disabled people need not respect the time limit.
gbsppy.why: Vehicles serving people with disabilities are exempt from the time limit in time-limited parking areas.

uexvkj.q: To park in a time-disc zone, you must set the end time of the stay on the disc, or write it on a sheet of paper.
uexvkj.why: The disc must show the arrival time, not the end time, and a handwritten sheet of paper is not valid.

1h23u5d.q: In a time-disc zone, before the parking time expires you may update the time without moving the vehicle.
1h23u5d.why: You may not update the disc without actually moving the vehicle; doing so is a violation.

d8kfac.q: In a metered parking zone you need not use the meter if you make a short stop.
d8kfac.why: The meter must be paid even for a short parking stay (sosta); only a quick passenger drop-off or pick-up is exempt.

130iq8h.q: To park in a time-disc zone, you must write the arrival hour on a sheet of paper, without the minutes.
130iq8h.why: The disc must be set to the arrival time including minutes; a paper note is not valid.

1qdgqhg.q: The driver of a car parked on the right side of an urban road must pay particular attention to approaching vehicles before opening the door.
1qdgqhg.why: Before opening a door you must check for approaching vehicles to avoid causing danger.

kcnj72.q: The driver of a car parked on a narrow road must check that no vehicles are approaching before getting out.
kcnj72.why: On a narrow road passing traffic comes very close, so check for approaching vehicles before getting out.

1hyubd7.q: It is advisable for the driver of a car parked on the left side of a one-way urban road to remind the passenger to pay particular attention to approaching vehicles before opening the door.
1hyubd7.why: Vehicles can pass on the left side of a one-way street too, so warn the passenger before they open the door.

8k8bry.q: It is advisable for the driver of a car parked on the right side of an urban road to remind the passenger opening the right-hand door to watch out for pedestrians.
8k8bry.why: The right door opens towards the pavement, so remind the passenger to check for passing pedestrians.

1nfptkm.q: The driver of a car may leave the engine running if parked for a short time.
1nfptkm.why: The engine must be switched off when parked (sosta), even briefly; leaving it running is forbidden.

rupcef.q: The driver of a car parked on a narrow road must worry about vehicles approaching from behind before getting out, but not those from the front.
rupcef.why: On a narrow road you must check for vehicles coming from both directions, front and rear.

o2zwnr.q: Before starting to drive a car, it is advisable to adjust the seat and headrest to your height.
o2zwnr.why: A correctly adjusted seat and headrest give you a proper driving position and protect you in a crash.

1tqblgy.q: Before starting to drive a car, it is advisable to adjust the interior and exterior rear-view mirrors.
1tqblgy.why: Properly adjusted mirrors give the best rear and side visibility.

h1hvoc.q: Before starting to ride a motorcycle, it is advisable to adjust the mirrors to your height.
h1hvoc.why: On a motorcycle too, mirrors should be adjusted to your height so you can see behind properly.

rwvllo.q: When driving a motor vehicle, you must carry all documents required for driving (vehicle registration document, insurance certificate, driving licence, etc.), and they must be valid.
rwvllo.why: You must carry valid driving documents: registration (carta di circolazione), insurance and driving licence (patente).

5dlloa.q: Before starting to drive a motor vehicle, you must be certain that your licence category allows you to drive it.
5dlloa.why: You may only drive vehicles covered by your licence category.

1qewps8.q: Before starting to drive a vehicle, you must be certain that it is in perfect working order.
1qewps8.why: The driver must check the vehicle is in good working order before setting off, for everyone's safety.

k0rmwu.q: Before starting to drive a vehicle, you must make sure that carried objects are arranged so they cannot fall or scatter.
k0rmwu.why: Loads must be secured so they cannot fall or spill and endanger other road users.

15hc03r.q: Before starting to drive a vehicle, you must check that rear and side visibility is not impaired by passengers or by a badly placed load.
15hc03r.why: Passengers or a badly placed load must not reduce your rear and side visibility.

15xk91b.q: Before starting to drive a car, you must locate the controls (levers and buttons) needed for driving and understand how they work.
15xk91b.why: The driver must know the controls well so they can be used correctly without distraction.

1ste950.q: Before starting to drive a car, you must check that the passengers have properly fastened their seatbelts.
1ste950.why: The driver must check that passengers have fastened their seatbelts before moving off.

xnmna8.q: Before starting to drive a motor vehicle, you must reset the trip odometer.
xnmna8.why: Resetting the trip odometer is not a safety check and is not required before driving.

1ngr3km.q: Before starting to drive a motor vehicle, you must deactivate the driver-side airbag.
1ngr3km.why: The driver's airbag is a safety device and must stay active; it must not be deactivated.

deauzl.q: Before starting to drive a car, you must check that the seatbelts have a pretensioner.
deauzl.why: The pretensioner is built into the vehicle; what you must check is that belts are fastened, not whether they have one.

1bsdpwh.q: Before starting to drive a vehicle, you must check its working order only if you are about to make a long journey.
1bsdpwh.why: The vehicle's condition must always be checked before driving, not only for long trips.

v6p38e.q: Arresto is the interruption of the vehicle's travel due to traffic requirements, such as at a red light.
v6p38e.why: An arresto is a stop forced by traffic conditions, such as a red light.

57hjsw.q: The fermata of a vehicle is the temporary suspension of travel to allow people to get on or off.
57hjsw.why: A fermata is a temporary halt in travel to let people board or alight.

1oewdui.q: The fermata of a vehicle is the temporary suspension of travel for needs of very short duration, such as asking traffic officers for information.
1oewdui.why: A fermata is a temporary halt for very brief needs, such as asking traffic officers for information.

9yfme8.q: The fermata of a vehicle is the temporary suspension of travel for needs of very short duration.
9yfme8.why: A fermata is a temporary halt in travel for needs of very short duration.

55tkin.q: Arresto is the temporary suspension of travel for the needs of the driver or the passengers of a vehicle.
55tkin.why: That describes a fermata; an arresto is a stop caused by traffic requirements.

b27t25.q: A fermata is the interruption of the vehicle's travel due to traffic requirements.
b27t25.why: That describes an arresto; a fermata is a brief halt to let people on or off or for very short needs.

11am4c9.q: A fermata for the driver's needs may last a maximum of ten minutes.
11am4c9.why: A fermata is only for very brief needs and has no ten-minute allowance; a longer halt is a sosta.

147khu0.q: A fermata of a vehicle is prohibited if more than one passenger gets off.
147khu0.why: There is no limit to how many passengers may get on or off during a fermata.

1fdswq6.q: A fermata must not obstruct traffic.
1fdswq6.why: A fermata must not obstruct traffic.

1s9a5e5.q: During a fermata the driver must not use their car to block the normal flow of traffic.
1s9a5e5.why: A stopped driver must not impede the normal flow of traffic.

c8lu3n.q: During a fermata the driver must behave so as not to endanger other road users.
c8lu3n.why: Even when stopped, the driver must avoid endangering other road users.

tl68ou.q: During a fermata the driver must always be present and ready to resume travel.
tl68ou.why: In a fermata the driver stays with the vehicle, ready to move off again.

1rsckwp.q: During a fermata the driver must always take appropriate precautions to avoid accidents.
1rsckwp.why: The driver must always take suitable precautions to prevent accidents, even during a fermata.

gzixxb.q: Stopping to ask traffic officers for information is not allowed when it may cause obstruction or slow down traffic.
gzixxb.why: Stopping to ask for information is allowed only if it does not obstruct or slow traffic.

rv9iux.q: During a fermata the driver may move away for a very short time before resuming travel.
rv9iux.why: In a fermata the driver must stay present and ready to go; walking away, even briefly, is not allowed.

1o7akdz.q: A fermata of a vehicle is always allowed in order to ask traffic officers for information.
1o7akdz.why: Not always: if stopping causes obstruction or slows traffic, it is not allowed.

eo6ug2.q: During a fermata, if the driver moves away, they must leave the vehicle with the engine running.
eo6ug2.why: If the driver leaves the vehicle the engine must be switched off; with the driver absent it is a sosta, not a fermata.

judhi1.q: In case of a fermata, where there is no raised pavement, the driver must leave a space of at least one metre for pedestrians to pass.
judhi1.why: Where there is no raised pavement (marciapiede) you must leave at least one metre for pedestrians.

m6bkwy.q: Outside built-up areas, in case of a fermata the driver must place the vehicle off the carriageway, if possible.
m6bkwy.why: Outside built-up areas, a stopped vehicle should be placed off the carriageway whenever possible.

1b9c8ud.q: Outside built-up areas, in case of a fermata the driver must place the vehicle off the carriageway, but not on cycle paths.
1b9c8ud.why: The vehicle goes off the carriageway but never on a cycle path (pista ciclabile), where stopping is prohibited.

umc9cx.q: Outside built-up areas, if the vehicle cannot be placed off the carriageway, the driver must make the fermata as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway.
umc9cx.why: If you cannot leave the carriageway, stop as close as possible to its right edge.

qg4gqs.q: In case of a fermata on an urban road with no raised pavement, the driver must place the vehicle as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway.
qg4gqs.why: With no raised pavement you must leave at least one metre for pedestrians, so you do not go as close to the edge as possible.

57nnm5.q: Outside built-up areas, in case of a fermata the driver is obliged to place the vehicle off the carriageway, if necessary on a cycle path.
57nnm5.why: Moving off the carriageway applies only if possible, and never onto a cycle path (pista ciclabile), where stopping is banned.

118joak.q: Fermata is prohibited at or near level crossings.
118joak.why: Stopping is banned at or near level crossings (passaggi a livello) for safety.

u8pwm8.q: Fermata is prohibited on railway or tram tracks, or so close to them as to obstruct rail vehicles.
u8pwm8.why: Stopping on rail or tram tracks, or close enough to obstruct rail vehicles, is prohibited.

1waarx5.q: Fermata is prohibited in tunnels, unless otherwise signposted.
1waarx5.why: Stopping in tunnels (gallerie) is prohibited unless signs indicate otherwise.

n6lg7x.q: Fermata is prohibited in underpasses, under overpasses, under archways and porticoes, unless otherwise signposted.
n6lg7x.why: Stopping is prohibited in underpasses (sottovia), under flyovers, archways and porticoes unless signs say otherwise.

1bns1qm.why: Stopping on a hump (dosso) is prohibited because visibility is limited.

zuq9ju.q: Outside built-up areas and on urban through roads, fermata is prohibited near humps.
zuq9ju.why: On rural roads and urban expressways, the ban applies near humps too, not just on them.

1f94trf.q: Fermata is prohibited on bends and, outside built-up areas and on urban through roads, also near them.
1f94trf.why: Stopping on bends is banned, and outside built-up areas and on urban expressways also near them.

kzl9pd.q: Fermata is prohibited along the right edge of the carriageway.
kzl9pd.why: The right edge of the carriageway is the normal place to stop.

p322xy.q: Fermata is prohibited along the left edge of a one-way carriageway.
p322xy.why: On one-way roads stopping is also allowed on the left side unless prohibited.

vbi0ku.q: A short-duration fermata is allowed even on a bend.
vbi0ku.why: Stopping on a bend is prohibited even if very brief, because of poor visibility.

1ny93bv.q: Fermata is prohibited at the entrances of driveways (passi carrabili).
1ny93bv.why: The fermata ban does not cover driveways (passi carrabili); parking is prohibited there but a brief stop is allowed.

r7vufs.q: Fermata is prohibited on areas intended for markets or for loading and unloading goods.
r7vufs.why: On these areas parking (sosta) is prohibited, but a brief stop (fermata) is allowed.

pwmrs5.q: Stopping is prohibited near or in front of vertical road signs so as to hide them from view
pwmrs5.why: A stopped vehicle must not hide vertical signs from drivers, so stopping near or in front of them is prohibited when it blocks the view.

1yv4ad4.q: Stopping is prohibited near or in front of traffic lights so as to hide them from view
1yv4ad4.why: Traffic lights must stay visible, so stopping near or in front of them is prohibited when the vehicle hides them.

1rqowsm.q: Stopping is prohibited at pre-selection road markings and along channelling lanes
1rqowsm.why: Stopping is banned on pre-selection arrows (preselezione) and in channelling lanes (corsie di canalizzazione), because it would disturb drivers choosing their direction.

10z91wg.q: Outside built-up areas, stopping is prohibited at and near intersections
10z91wg.why: Outside built-up areas stopping is banned on and close to intersections, because it blocks visibility and manoeuvres.

1230o95.q: In built-up areas, stopping and parking are prohibited at intersections and within 5 metres of them, unless otherwise signed.
1230o95.why: In built-up areas both stopping and parking are banned on intersections and within 5 metres of them, unless signs say otherwise.

34b8hl.q: Stopping is prohibited, only during opening hours, in front of fuel stations
34b8hl.why: At fuel stations it is parking (sosta) that is banned during opening hours, not stopping (fermata).

1gl7o6e.q: Stopping is prohibited after the NO PARKING sign
1gl7o6e.why: The no parking sign bans only parking (sosta); a brief stop (fermata), for example to let someone out, is still allowed.

18pnbip.q: Stopping is prohibited near road signs, even if the vehicle does not hide them from view
18pnbip.why: Stopping near signs is banned only when the vehicle hides them from view. If they stay visible, stopping is allowed.

1l15ka4.q: Stopping is prohibited along motorways, even in an emergency
1l15ka4.why: On motorways stopping is banned, but in an emergency, such as a breakdown or illness, it is allowed in the emergency lane (corsia di emergenza).

1g716ic.q: In built-up areas, stopping is prohibited near intersections, at more than 5 metres
1g716ic.why: In built-up areas the ban covers up to 5 metres from an intersection. Beyond 5 metres stopping is not prohibited for this reason.

1fqed97.q: Stopping is allowed on acceleration lanes, provided it is very brief
1fqed97.why: Stopping on acceleration lanes is banned however brief, because vehicles are joining the traffic flow there.

krvcdy.q: Parking and stopping are always prohibited on pedestrian crossings
krvcdy.why: Stopping and parking are always banned on pedestrian crossings (attraversamenti pedonali) to protect pedestrians.

1sj98xe.q: Parking and stopping are prohibited in every case on cycle paths and at their exits
1sj98xe.why: Stopping and parking are banned in all cases on cycle paths (piste ciclabili) and where they join the road.

e2w3fm.q: Parking and stopping are prohibited on pavements, unless otherwise signed
e2w3fm.why: Stopping and parking on pavements (marciapiedi) are banned unless a sign allows it.

1058ahn.q: Stopping is allowed at the exit of driveways
1058ahn.why: Parking in front of a driveway (passo carrabile) is banned, but a brief stop is allowed because it does not block access for long.

cfy2ti.q: Stopping is allowed in front of urban waste bins
cfy2ti.why: Parking in front of waste bins is banned, but stopping is allowed.

1p8p2qj.q: Stopping is allowed on pedestrian crossings to let a passenger out
1p8p2qj.why: Stopping on pedestrian crossings is always banned, even to let a passenger out.

c4h0hv.q: Stopping for a very brief need is prohibited on cycle paths but not at their exits
c4h0hv.why: The stopping ban applies both on cycle paths and at their exits, with no difference between them.

j35v9.q: Stopping is always prohibited in the second row
j35v9.why: Double parking (seconda fila) is banned, but a brief stop in the second row is allowed if it does not obstruct traffic.

za32h4.q: Stopping is prohibited in every case during night hours
za32h4.why: There is no general ban on stopping at night. The same rules apply as during the day.

1szmwwq.q: Parking is the suspension of the vehicle's movement for an extended time, with the driver able to walk away
1szmwwq.why: Parking (sosta) is a prolonged halt of the vehicle during which the driver may leave it.

1u4xg6k.q: While parked, the driver may leave the vehicle
1u4xg6k.why: During parking the driver is free to walk away, unlike during a brief stop (fermata).

k63kcn.q: While parked, the driver must take suitable precautions to avoid accidents
k63kcn.why: A driver who parks must take the precautions needed to prevent accidents.

1ei9hyh.q: While parked, the driver must prevent the vehicle from being used without their consent
1ei9hyh.why: The driver must prevent unauthorised use of the vehicle, for example by removing the key and locking it.

19glqqs.q: While parked, it is advisable for the driver to apply the parking brake and engage the lowest gear
19glqqs.why: When parking, apply the handbrake (freno di stazionamento) and engage first gear so the vehicle cannot move.

ebac1o.q: While parked, the driver must take measures to keep the vehicle immobile, whatever the slope of the road
ebac1o.why: The vehicle must always be kept from moving, on any slope, using the handbrake and a gear.

1fher0j.q: When parked on steep roads, it is advisable for the driver to apply the parking brake, engage the lowest gear and leave the vehicle with the wheels turned towards the kerb
1fher0j.why: On steep roads use the handbrake, the lowest gear and turn the wheels towards the kerb (marciapiede).

r03041.q: While parked, the driver must leave the vehicle with the engine off
r03041.why: The engine must be switched off when parked. Leaving it running is forbidden.

1j3sxff.q: While parked at night, the driver must in every case leave the position lights on
1j3sxff.why: Position lights are needed when parked at night only where visibility is poor, for example on unlit roads, not in every case.

r26iva.q: While parked, the driver may not leave the vehicle for more than three hours
r26iva.why: There is no general three-hour limit. Parking duration depends on local rules and signs.

1xiepk8.q: When parked on an uphill road, the driver must make sure to engage fourth gear
1xiepk8.why: On an uphill road engage the lowest gear, which is first, not fourth.

xzwxdy.q: While parked, the driver must put the car's gearbox in neutral
xzwxdy.why: When parked a gear must be engaged, not neutral, to help keep the car still.

6cpkgt.q: Unless otherwise signed, a driver parking in a built-up area must place the vehicle as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway, parallel to it and in the direction of travel, provided a raised pavement exists
6cpkgt.why: In built-up areas park close to the right edge, parallel to it and facing the direction of travel, where there is a raised pavement (marciapiede rialzato).

6n7kc5.q: When parking where there is no raised pavement, the driver must leave a space of at least one metre for pedestrians to pass
6n7kc5.why: Where there is no raised pavement, leave at least one metre of free space for pedestrians.

gntm2c.q: Outside built-up areas, a driver who must park is required to place the vehicle off the carriageway where possible
gntm2c.why: Outside built-up areas park off the carriageway (carreggiata) whenever possible.

vhgll1.q: Outside built-up areas, a driver who must park is required to place the vehicle off the carriageway, but not on cycle paths
vhgll1.why: Park off the carriageway outside built-up areas, but never on cycle paths, where stopping and parking are banned.

13hybta.q: Outside built-up areas, the driver must place a parked vehicle off the carriageway, but not on the hard shoulder, unless otherwise signed
13hybta.why: Outside built-up areas the vehicle should be placed off the carriageway, but not on the hard shoulder (banchina), unless signs allow it.

118p7ro.q: Outside built-up areas, if it is impossible to place the vehicle off the carriageway, the driver must park as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway
118p7ro.why: If you cannot park off the carriageway, park as close as possible to its right edge.

pz1uy8.q: When parking in a built-up area, the driver must place the vehicle as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway, even where there is no raised pavement
pz1uy8.why: Without a raised pavement, parking at the right edge is not enough: you must leave pedestrians at least one metre of free space.

1gkppa.q: Outside built-up areas, when parking the driver must place the vehicle off the carriageway, if necessary even on cycle paths
1gkppa.why: Cycle paths are never allowed for parking: stopping and parking there are banned in every case.

1von2vu.q: Outside built-up areas, if it is impossible to place the vehicle off the carriageway, the driver must not park
1von2vu.why: If there is no room off the carriageway, parking is still allowed, as close as possible to the right edge.

9pugks.q: On one-way urban streets, parking is also permitted along the left edge of the carriageway, provided enough space remains for at least one line of vehicles to pass
9pugks.why: On one-way urban streets you may park on the left if enough space remains for one line of traffic to pass.

1im1bzg.q: On one-way urban streets, parking is also permitted along the left edge of the carriageway, provided a width of at least three metres remains for vehicles to pass
1im1bzg.why: On one-way urban streets you may park on the left if at least three metres of width remain free for traffic.

vv8isy.q: In areas set aside for parking, the driver must place the vehicle as indicated by the signs and markings
vv8isy.why: In parking areas place the vehicle as the signs and markings require, for example angled or perpendicular.

k14buk.q: In areas where parking spaces are marked by road markings, the driver must always place the vehicle within one of the bays, without encroaching on adjacent ones
k14buk.why: Where bays are marked, the vehicle must stay entirely within one bay (stallo) and not occupy neighbouring ones.

1i71l47.q: On one-way urban streets, parking is always permitted along the left edge of the carriageway as well
1i71l47.why: Parking on the left is not always allowed: enough space must remain, at least three metres, and no ban may apply.

chxwga.q: It is prohibited to park cars or motorcycles in built-up areas when there are no parking stripes
chxwga.why: In built-up areas parking is not banned just because there are no marked bays. The general rules and signed bans apply.

1ww1zby.q: In areas where parking spaces are marked by road markings, the driver may place the vehicle outside the bay assigned to it, provided the parking is of very short duration
1ww1zby.why: The vehicle must always be inside its bay (stallo), even for a very short time. Duration makes no difference.

i069px.q: In a zone where parking is regulated by a parking meter, it is not necessary to use it if the parking is short
i069px.why: Where a parking meter (parchimetro) applies, you must pay even for a short stay. Only a mere stop does not require a ticket.

jaqdvs.q: Parking is prohibited at or near level crossings
jaqdvs.why: Parking is banned at and near level crossings (passaggi a livello) so that access to the tracks stays clear.

1rd9fcs.q: Parking is prohibited on railway or tram tracks, or so close to them as to obstruct the movement of rail vehicles
1rd9fcs.why: Parking is banned on railway and tram tracks and anywhere so close that it obstructs rail vehicles.

19gcey1.q: Parking is prohibited in tunnels, unless otherwise signed
19gcey1.why: Parking in tunnels (gallerie) is banned unless a sign says otherwise.

tsds5x.q: Parking is prohibited in underpasses, under overpasses, under archways and under porticoes, unless otherwise signed
tsds5x.why: Parking is banned in underpasses (sottovia), under overpasses, archways and porticoes, unless signs allow it.

gw8ai.why: Parking on humps (dossi) is banned because the vehicle would not be seen from far away.

pyv9p8.q: Outside built-up areas and on urban through roads, parking is prohibited near humps
pyv9p8.why: Outside built-up areas and on urban through roads (strade di scorrimento) the parking ban on humps also covers the area near them.

1m8mf3m.q: Parking is prohibited at level crossings but not near them
1m8mf3m.why: The parking ban applies both at and near level crossings.

1nxlsy7.q: Parking is prohibited on railway tracks but not on tram tracks
1nxlsy7.why: Parking is banned on both railway and tram tracks.

yvungw.q: Parking is allowed in lit tunnels
yvungw.why: Parking in tunnels is banned even when they are lit, unless signs say otherwise.

prsuym.q: Parking, but not stopping, is prohibited in underpasses, under overpasses, under archways and under porticoes
prsuym.why: In underpasses, under overpasses, archways and porticoes both parking and stopping are banned.

1h6rm4c.q: Outside built-up areas and on urban through roads, parking is allowed near humps.
1h6rm4c.why: Outside built-up areas and on urban through roads, parking near humps is banned.

6b89au.q: Parking and stopping are prohibited on bends and, outside built-up areas and on urban through roads, also near them
6b89au.why: Stopping and parking are banned on bends, and near them outside built-up areas and on urban through roads.

1fggmu8.q: Parking and stopping are prohibited near and in front of vertical road signs so as to hide them from view
1fggmu8.why: Stopping and parking are banned near or in front of vertical signs when the vehicle hides them from view.

1xfyu4x.q: Parking and stopping are prohibited near and in front of traffic lights so as to hide them from view
1xfyu4x.why: Stopping and parking are banned near or in front of traffic lights when the vehicle hides them from view.

19otogl.q: Stopping and parking are prohibited at preselection road markings and along channelling lanes.
19otogl.why: Both stopping and parking are banned on preselection markings and channelling lanes (corsie di canalizzazione), because they would block vehicles lining up for the junction.

1cdj4h5.q: Outside built-up areas, stopping and parking are prohibited at and near junction areas.
1cdj4h5.why: Outside built-up areas too, stopping and parking are banned at junctions and close to them.

6hiezz.q: Parking is prohibited at the exit of driveways.
6hiezz.why: The exit of a driveway (passo carrabile) must stay clear, so parking in front of it is banned.

1ect327.q: Parking is prohibited on bends but, outside built-up areas and on urban through roads, it is not prohibited near them.
1ect327.why: Parking is banned on bends and also near them, whatever the type of road and whether or not it is in a built-up area.

lw98ps.q: Parking, but not stopping, is prohibited near and in front of traffic lights so as to hide them from view.
lw98ps.why: Both stopping and parking are banned where the vehicle hides traffic lights from view.

1f4nb0y.q: Parking is prohibited at preselection road markings but not along channelling lanes.
1f4nb0y.why: The ban applies both on preselection markings and along channelling lanes (corsie di canalizzazione).

dwfmnk.q: Outside built-up areas, parking is prohibited at junction areas but not near them.
dwfmnk.why: The ban covers both the junction itself and the area near it, even outside built-up areas.

2fllq7.q: Parking, but not stopping, is prohibited on pedestrian crossings.
2fllq7.why: On pedestrian crossings both parking and stopping are prohibited.

1gnbzkx.q: Parking is prohibited on cycle paths, but not at their entrances if it is of short duration.
1gnbzkx.why: Parking is banned on cycle paths and at their entrances, even for a short time.

96tohh.q: Parking on pavements is allowed only if it is of short duration.
96tohh.why: Parking on pavements (marciapiedi) is banned even for a short time, unless signs say otherwise.

87tevy.q: Parking is prohibited if it prevents access to another vehicle that is already lawfully parked.
87tevy.why: You may not park in a way that blocks access to a vehicle that is already lawfully parked.

y7k81n.q: Parking is prohibited wherever it prevents parked vehicles from moving.
y7k81n.why: Parking is banned anywhere it stops other parked vehicles from moving out.

pknzae.q: Parking in the second row is prohibited, unless the vehicles are two-wheelers.
pknzae.why: Double parking (seconda fila) is banned, with an exception only for two-wheeled vehicles.

dgjm77.q: Parking is prohibited in spaces reserved for the stopping and standing of buses, trolleybuses and rail vehicles.
dgjm77.why: Spaces reserved for buses, trolleybuses and rail vehicles must stay clear, so parking there is banned.

rz9pd2.q: Parking is prohibited within 15 metres of the bus, trolleybus and rail vehicle stop sign when the stopping spaces are not marked out.
rz9pd2.why: If the stop area is not marked out, parking is banned within 15 metres of the public transport stop sign.

1ajkgs8.q: Double parking of motor vehicles is allowed for a few minutes if the hazard lights are on.
1ajkgs8.why: Double parking is always banned; using hazard lights does not make it legal.

plb5tc.q: Double parking of motor vehicles is allowed as long as enough space remains for two lines of vehicles to circulate.
plb5tc.why: Double parking is banned even when enough room is left for traffic to pass.

pmknk3.q: Parking is allowed in spaces reserved for the stopping and standing of buses, trolleybuses and rail vehicles provided it is brief.
pmknk3.why: Parking in these reserved spaces is banned, however short the time.

1ld5zcn.q: Parking is prohibited in spaces reserved for taxis (public service vehicles).
1ld5zcn.why: Spaces for taxis (veicoli in servizio di piazza) are reserved, so parking there is banned.

83lu4f.q: Parking is prohibited in market areas and in areas for loading and unloading goods, during the hours set.
83lu4f.why: Parking is banned in market areas and loading/unloading areas during the hours indicated.

k3lwi5.q: Parking is prohibited on the hard shoulder, unless otherwise signposted.
k3lwi5.why: Parking on the hard shoulder (banchina) is banned unless signs allow it.

pfgun.q: Parking is prohibited in spaces reserved for the stopping or parking of vehicles for disabled people.
pfgun.why: Spaces reserved for vehicles of disabled people are off limits to others, so parking there is banned.

mcqjg.q: Parking is prohibited at ramps or links between pavements and the carriageway used by vehicles for disabled people.
mcqjg.why: Ramps and links between the pavement and the road used by vehicles for disabled people must stay clear, so parking there is banned.

1f604c.q: Parking is allowed in spaces reserved for taxis only if it does not last a long time.
1f604c.why: Parking in taxi spaces is banned even for a short time.

hodqn0.q: Parking is allowed in areas for loading and unloading goods, during the hours set, only if it is of short duration.
hodqn0.why: During the set hours parking there is banned, however short.

l04dh8.q: Parking is allowed in spaces reserved for the stopping or parking of vehicles for disabled people provided it is of short duration.
l04dh8.why: Parking in disabled spaces is banned for unauthorised drivers even for a short time.

1q37myz.q: Parking is prohibited in lanes or carriageways reserved for public transport.
1q37myz.why: Lanes and carriageways reserved for public transport are no-parking areas.

k72015.q: Parking is prohibited in urban pedestrian areas.
k72015.why: Parking is banned in urban pedestrian areas (aree pedonali urbane).

1m069yv.q: Parking is prohibited in limited traffic zones for unauthorised vehicles.
1m069yv.why: In a ZTL (limited traffic zone) unauthorised vehicles may not park.

1qcqun7.q: Parking is prohibited in spaces intended for emergency or public hygiene services as indicated by the appropriate signs.
1qcqun7.why: Signposted spaces for emergency or public hygiene services are no-parking areas.

skz4c2.q: Parking is prohibited in front of urban waste bins.
skz4c2.why: Parking in front of waste bins is banned because it obstructs refuse collection.

e1w9cp.q: Short stops are allowed in urban pedestrian areas.
e1w9cp.why: Vehicles cannot normally enter urban pedestrian areas, so even short stops are not allowed except for authorised ones.

qrw3r5.q: Both parking and stopping are prohibited in spaces intended for emergency or public hygiene services as indicated by the appropriate signs.
qrw3r5.why: The ban applies to parking only; stopping in these spaces is not prohibited.

m8j003.q: Parking, as well as stopping, is prohibited in front of urban waste bins.
m8j003.why: In front of waste bins only parking is banned; stopping is not.

9tikwj.q: In built-up areas the driver must not leave a trailer parked detached from the towing vehicle, unless otherwise signposted.
9tikwj.why: In built-up areas a trailer detached from its towing vehicle may not be left parked unless signs allow it.

17vcoy6.q: Where parking is expressly prohibited by a rule of the highway code, observing that ban does not depend on the presence of road signs.
17vcoy6.why: Parking bans written directly in the highway code apply even with no signs.

z4e989.q: Parking is prohibited at fuel pumps, up to 5 metres before and after, even when the pumps are closed.
z4e989.why: The code sets no 5-metre parking ban before and after fuel pumps.

gtw1u3.q: Where parking is expressly prohibited by a rule of the highway code, observing that ban is still dependent on the presence of road signs.
gtw1u3.why: A ban set by the code itself applies on its own, without any signs.

1ogtcbf.q: Parking in spaces reserved for the stopping and standing of buses, trolleybuses and rail vehicles results, among other things, in points being deducted from the licence.
1ogtcbf.why: This offence carries a fine and also a deduction of licence points (punti patente).

1p5s00u.q: Parking within 15 metres of the bus stop sign, when the stopping spaces are not marked out, results, among other things, in points being deducted from the licence.
1p5s00u.why: This offence also carries a fine plus a deduction of licence points.

15gbtb5.q: Parking in spaces reserved for the stopping and parking of vehicles for disabled people results, among other things, in points being deducted from the licence.
15gbtb5.why: Parking in disabled spaces brings a fine and a deduction of licence points.

gdigkk.q: Parking at ramps or links between pavements and the carriageway used by vehicles for disabled people results, among other things, in points being deducted from the licence.
gdigkk.why: Parking on these ramps and links also brings a fine and a deduction of licence points.

mlb9fh.q: Parking in lanes or carriageways reserved for public transport results, among other things, in points being deducted from the licence.
mlb9fh.why: This parking offence carries a fine and a deduction of licence points.

c0xjgs.q: Parking in spaces reserved for the stopping and standing of buses, trolleybuses and rail vehicles is allowed if a parking disc is used.
c0xjgs.why: Parking in these spaces is always banned; a parking disc (disco orario) does not make it legal.

8go26o.q: Parking less than 15 metres from the bus stop sign, when the stopping spaces are not marked out, is allowed by activating the hazard warning lights (four flashers simultaneously).
8go26o.why: Within 15 metres of the stop sign parking is banned; hazard lights do not make it legal.

77bnxt.q: Parking in spaces reserved for the stopping and parking of vehicles for disabled people results in a financial penalty, but not in points being deducted from the driver's licence.
77bnxt.why: Besides the fine, licence points are also deducted.

1cv8axd.q: Parking at ramps or links between pavements and the carriageway used by vehicles for disabled people results in suspension of the licence.
1cv8axd.why: The penalty is a fine and a deduction of points, not licence suspension.

2pqek8.q: Parking in lanes or carriageways reserved for public transport is allowed, in built-up areas, from 10 p.m. to 8 a.m.
2pqek8.why: Parking in public transport lanes is banned at all hours, with no night-time exception.

1tqwe4b.q: An emergency stop is an interruption of travel when the vehicle is unusable because of a breakdown.
1tqwe4b.why: An emergency stop (sosta di emergenza) is a halt made because a breakdown makes the vehicle unusable.

1crkloa.q: An emergency stop is an interruption of travel when the vehicle must stop because of the physical illness of the driver or a passenger.
1crkloa.why: A stop caused by the physical illness of the driver or a passenger also counts as an emergency stop (sosta di emergenza).

1jyyd4e.q: An emergency stop is an interruption of travel due to traffic requirements.
1jyyd4e.why: A stop due to traffic needs is not an emergency stop; that term covers breakdown or sudden illness.

76xlat.q: An emergency stop is the temporary suspension of travel to allow a disabled person to get out.
76xlat.why: This is just an ordinary stop (fermata), not an emergency stop.

1nu1v70.q: An emergency stop is the temporary suspension of travel to allow a disabled person to get into the vehicle.
1nu1v70.why: This is just an ordinary stop (fermata), not an emergency stop.

13g0727.q: When opening the doors of a vehicle, you must make sure that doing so is not a danger or obstruction to other road users.
13g0727.why: When opening doors you must make sure you do not endanger or obstruct other road users.

j19m7t.q: Before opening a vehicle door on the side facing the centre of the road, you must make sure no other vehicles are approaching.
j19m7t.why: Before opening a door on the traffic side you must check that no vehicles are coming.

ujsaf5.q: Before opening a vehicle door on the side facing the pavement, you must make sure no pedestrians are approaching.
ujsaf5.why: Before opening a door on the pavement side you must check that no pedestrians are coming.

en8pvl.q: When getting out of a vehicle, you must make sure it is not a danger or obstruction to other road users.
en8pvl.why: When getting out you must make sure you do not endanger or obstruct other road users.

cqhnn2.q: When about to get out of the motor vehicle, the driver must make sure, also by using the rear-view mirror, that no other vehicles are approaching.
cqhnn2.why: Before getting out the driver must check, also with the mirror, that no vehicles are approaching.

1yzyxd0.q: Before getting out of a parked vehicle, the driver must make sure the engine is switched off.
1yzyxd0.why: Before leaving a parked vehicle you must switch the engine off.

1ezsgzy.q: Opening a vehicle door on the pavement side requires activating the direction indicator on that side.
1ezsgzy.why: Opening a door on the pavement side does not require using the indicator.

g49evy.q: Opening the vehicle doors on the side facing the centre of the road is prohibited.
g49evy.why: It is not forbidden to open doors on the road side; you only need to check that no vehicles are coming.

mb2cof.q: The driver may leave the parked vehicle with the engine running to keep the air conditioning working.
mb2cof.why: When leaving a parked vehicle the engine must be switched off, even to keep the air conditioning on.

12a695t.q: Before getting out of a parked vehicle, the driver must apply the handbrake on all downhill roads but not on uphill ones.
12a695t.why: The handbrake must always be applied, whether the road is downhill, uphill or flat.
